policy: Accepted data sources: public domain (NOAA ICOADS, NOAA OISST, Natural Earth) or CC-BY-4.0 (Copernicus Marine, only with attribution and registration). NC/ND banned.
Every data file shipped in site/data/ must have an entry here.
The site footer data line is rendered from meta.source and must always name the source actually in use.
A data file with no manifest entry is a build failure (make validate), not a warning.
